tools.name: review_claim_requirements
tools.description: Given a claim scenario (payer + CPT/HCPCS), return structured billing requirements: timely filing, prior auth hints, required attachments, and citation resource URIs for the underlying payer policy PDFs. Does NOT return PDF bytes — use resources or read_document_bytes so the MCP App can render documents for the human claims reviewer.

tools.name: list_policy_library
tools.description: List demo payer policy documents available as MCP resources.

tools.name: read_document_bytes
tools.description: App-only: stream a policy PDF (or Apps shell) in base64 chunks. Keeps large claim paperwork out of model context.
